levels.sub: The Mint, the clan vaults and the Great Vault

marks.name: The great lift
marks.why: Stops here only for those who hold a key; the spiral stair round its well is barred the same way

marks.name: Third gate
marks.why: One passage, three gates, guards at every one

marks.name: The Mint
marks.why: Hearths, coin presses, counting tables: dwarven coin is struck here

marks.name: Assay office
marks.why: Every ingot tested

marks.name: Die room
marks.why: The coin dies, under lock

marks.name: Coin-masters’ quarters
marks.why: They live here; the dies never leave

marks.name: The Great Door
marks.why: A round vault door the height of ten dwarves

marks.name: The Great Vault
marks.why: The clan’s hoard: drifts of gold among colossal pillars

marks.name: Counting dais
marks.why: At the far end of the causeway

marks.name: Clan vaults (west)
marks.why: Strongrooms of the clans under the Anvilborn

marks.name: The Goldwarden’s hall
marks.why: Elder of the Mint; the only elder who holds a vault key

levels.name: The Works
levels.sub: The brewhouses and fungus farms, the forges, the cisterns and the way to the mines

marks.name: The great lift
marks.why: The Great Lift and the Great Stair round it: one axis from the deepest mine to the Summit

marks.name: Stair to the Warrens & the mines
marks.why: Down to the troglodyte floor, and the deep workings below it

marks.name: Worksmaster’s hall
marks.why: Seat of the elder over every craft on this floor

marks.name: Hall of Fine Crafts
marks.why: Jewellers, gem-cutters, goldsmiths, engravers, runecarvers

marks.name: Hall of Common Crafts
marks.why: Leatherworkers, weavers and dyers, potters, glassblowers, tinkers

marks.name: The gallery
marks.why: West to the brewhouses, east to the forges

marks.name: Brewhouses
marks.why: Copper kettles; the mead that made the dwarves big drinkers

marks.name: Fungus farms
marks.why: The secret ingredient

marks.name: Hot springs
marks.why: Warmth for the fungus and the cellars

marks.name: The Steel Forge
marks.why: Sealed; Dornish Steel is made here

marks.name: Cisterns
marks.why: The Falls’ water, stored for the forges and the siege

marks.name: South-west stair
marks.why: Up to the Gate & Throne, past the Mint

marks.name: South-east stair
marks.why: Up to the Gate & Throne, past the Mint

marks.name: Brewing wing
marks.why: Kettles, cooperages, malting floors, honey stores, drying racks

marks.name: Smithing wing
marks.why: Forges, smithies, bellows, hammer mills, ore and charcoal yards

marks.name: The chasm
marks.why: Bottomless; it cuts through every level below the Gate

levels.name: The Warrens
levels.sub: The troglodytes’ floor, half home and half mine

marks.name: The Great Lift & Stair
marks.why: From the deepest mine to the Summit; ore goes up from here

marks.name: Stair up to the Works
marks.why: Dwarven-cut, the way the troglodytes go to work

marks.name: The Overseer’s hall
marks.why: Grubbik Ignis: he speaks and votes for the troglodytes, and listens on everything else

marks.name: The Warren gate
marks.why: Where the dwarf-cut landing ends and the warrens begin

marks.name: The Great Warren
marks.why: The biggest cave; dens round the fire pits

marks.name: Ore heaps
marks.why: Hauled to the lift

marks.name: Old workings
marks.why: Running off toward the deep mines; only the miners know where they end
